opening.comment: The agent did not give their own name or the company name in the first turn, only a bare hello.

verification.quote: Agent: Yes. Thank you, Niamh, that matches your account.
verification.comment: The caller gave their name and postcode, and the agent confirmed the match, but the agent used a name that differs from the one the caller stated, so the check was not clearly completed as required.

understanding.quote: Agent: So the toaster arrived yesterday and turn on at or?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue partly, but the question was garbled and the caller's answer was unclear, so the issue was not properly confirmed.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: I'll refund the full €22.00 to your cards, you'll see it 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Under the policy, a faulty item under EUR 25 needs no return and a refund is paid within 5 working days, so the timeline is right, but the agent did not verify the item was faulty and the refund was promised before a photo was requested.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'll refund the full €22.00 to your cards, you'll see it 5 working days.
process_compliance.comment: The agent did not ask for a photo before arranging the refund for a faulty item, as the policy requires.

communication.comment: The agent was brief and somewhat curt, and did not acknowledge the caller's disappointment in a warm way beyond one short apology.

closing.comment: The agent did not confirm next steps clearly or ask if there was anything else, and ended the call abruptly.
